description: This Java source file defines the 'FieldToSession' class, which implements a method operation used within the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework. The class captures the logic for transferring a field value from a method's environment map into an HTTP session attribute, based on an XML element configuration. It includes validation, instantiation via a factory pattern, and execution logic tied to MiniLang's method context.

classes.name: FieldToSession
classes.description: Implements a MiniLang method operation that stores a specified field value into the user's session under a configurable attribute name.

classes.name: FieldToSession.FieldToSessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToSession based on XML configuration.

methods.name: FieldToSession
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation from an XML element and validation context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: if in event mode, retrieves a field value from the environment map and sets it in the session with an attribute name derived from configuration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation in XML-like syntax for debugging.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new FieldToSession instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation as used in XML configuration ('field-to-session').
